executive_risk_memo: Across 2024-2026 on Ethereum Mainnet, Fraxtal Bridge's L1StandardBridgeProxy (0x34C0bD5877A5Ee7099D0f5688D65F4bB9158BDE2, backing $15.73M Fraxtal chain TVL on DefiLlama) hardened rapidly from its 1-of-1 launch Safe at block 19,135,324 (2024-02-01) to a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe (0xe0d7755252873c4eF5788f7f45764E0e17610508) within 48 hours, rotated one signer at block 19,976,724 (2024-05-29), and executed three verified 0-second L1StandardBridge upgrades at blocks 19,870,533, 22,376,688, and 23,169,976 without adding a timelock, Safe guard, or module through block 26,450,584. Documentation forensics establish a partially repaired trajectory: upstream Superchain Registry PR #877 closed signer/controller opacity after 476 days (block 22,539,132 on 2025-05-22), yet FraxFinance/docs misc/constants/mainnet.ts still publishes the retired Feb 2024 implementation (0xCC26248B...) after three subsequent upgrades (919 days open through 2026-11-19 UTC). Engineering telemetry shows healthy maintainer velocity in FraxFinance/fraxtal (61 contracts-bedrock commits, 33 human contributors, bus_factor = 3) and Blockscout-verified 0.8.15 implementations before execution.
